title: Daily briefing: Can you name every female Nobel laureate?
title_zh: 每日简报：你能列举所有女性诺贝尔奖得主吗？
abstract: Test yourself on your science Nobel knowledge. Plus, how butterfly markings mislead the eye and how to respond to hate speech without fuelling it further.
abstract_zh: 测试你对科学诺贝尔奖的了解。此外，蝴蝶纹理如何误导视线，以及如何在不进一步激化仇恨言论的情况下作出回应。
